bestBets.overview: At the time of writing (Monday) the track is rated a soft 5 and with light rain forecast race day there should be some give in the surface. THEM'S THE BREAKS got little room when required over this route fresh and has found the line well over 1600m at both subsequent runs. The return to 2100m looks ideal now and she should take plenty of holding out. HONEST WARRIOR appreciated the step up to the mile when scoring third up and the further rise in trip may suit all the more. REGAL HUNTER was twice game in defeat on synthetic and was again sound when back to turf last time. LAST TREMBLE next.

raceTips.comment: Them's The Breaks looks ready to win now fully fit and rising in distance. She should map for a nice run and be hard to beat.Honest Warrior won with favours last start but looks well placed here.

bestBets.overview: ALFARINO was game in defeat behind a promising one at his second attempt. He's been given time to mature and placed in the latest of two lead-in trials. ROLAND VIEW has been sound at big odds at both runs back from a long break, strips fitter for them and can't be taken lightly this time. TSUYOI KITSUNE led and gave a big sight fresh. He may be a genuine improver this time in. The debutante ANNIE'S PRIDE draws wide but has placed in both trials and comes from an astute yard.

raceTips.comment: Tsuyoi Kitsune ran a huge race last start at $51 when only just getting caught late for 2nd. He looks to have found a very winnable race here. Alfarino has trialled ok and could be in the finish fresh. Lin Thizzy can sprint well fresh.

KAKIA has the outside alley to overcome but has been sound at all three runs this time in. WINDARA ROCK IT weas confidently backed when just missing on debut, then was a drifter in betting when failing to finish off next try.

bestBets.overview: The on-pacer SUSHI EXPRESS was only worn down late when rising to 1380m second up. He should lead these for fun and is unbeaten from five tries at this longer trip. Hobart Cup winner BLONDE STAR failed to finish off fresh but will be better for the hitout and has only missed the quinella once in four second up runs. RUBBLEONTHEDOUBLE has returned from a break in fine fettle scoring at two of three attempts and he strips hard fit for them. ZEWINNA hasn't been far away at either outing since scoring three back.

raceTips.comment: Rubbleonthedouble is flying of late and looks to have found another race here rising to the mile. He should map for a nice run and be hard to beat. Blonde Star is the class horse being a Hobart Cup winner, she'll improve rising in distance. Sushi Express will map well here.

bestBets.overview: NATIVE CLAN scored a tough on-pace win over several key rivals over 2100m last time. The rise to 2400m is a slight query but she draws to advantage and should take plenty of wearing down again. Stablemate HAPPY CLAN closed well behind her last start and was successful at his only other try this route. DON'T GIVE UP battled away soundly behind that pair and gives the impression the rise to 2400m will be a positive. MERLIN BEACH is unknown at 2400m but he's very honest.

raceTips.comment: Don't Give Up looks ready to win now rising in distance to 2400m. He hasn't had much luck in recent runs. This looks a suitable race on paper. Native Clan could get favours here on pace. Merlin Beach maybe a query at the trip but is very consistent.

THE SPIRIT OF ZERO hit the line hard over 1009m fresh before proving no match for the victor over 1350m second up. The rise to the mile is ideal for him now. HENLEY EXTRME scored well third up and can cope with the rise in grade. JUST A NEEDS was plain last time but boasts a consistent record this route.

raceTips.comment: Coal River chased a fast tempo first up and just peaked on his run late first up at the mile. Now fitter here he should be be hard to beat. Thisismyturf is flying of late but needs another win. The Spirit Of Zero is similar he is racing well but does struggle to win.
